rows.name: normal-headless-startup
rows.proofScope: Same-generation original N15 used fixed native launch and asserted exit0, empty stderr and exact10 responses. Valid post-startup frames plus exact source gate prove startup; direct spawnSync supplies no production-supervisor event or cleanup telemetry.

scope.nativeSmoke: The same-generation N15 PASS retains ten native exchanges under the fixed launch and original assertions of helper exit0, empty stderr and valid matching response. These post-startup frames plus the exact source gate establish positive sole-PID membership, successful self-FreeConsole and request consumption. No duplicate product helper is launched for security. N15 uses direct spawnSync; no actual production-supervisor event or cleanup telemetry is claimed.
scope.nativeDoubles: Exact extracted Confirm-ConsoleQuiescence; controlled native returns/throws validate code branches. These do not claim forced live OS failures, live host identity or host exit.
scope.zeroErrors: All zero returns reject without reading LastError. Cases6,5,203 carry configured unconsumed error contexts; no native last-error value is synthesized or treated as an absence witness.
scope.transportDoubles: Production transport/supervisor with in-memory child/stream doubles and injected monotonic time; no OS process or real-time scheduling proof.
scope.host: No host discovery/open/wait/termination and no console allocation/attachment; no unidentified host death claim.
